title: Ultra Steel UJ75041S-1 40-Piece 1/4" & 3/8" Drive Socket Set (New)

comparisons.notes: Vendor ULTRA STEEL, SKU UJ75041S-1, barcode 047669042361. Same 40-piece 1/4 and 3/8 inch drive set with blow-mold case, available at $29.99.

writeup: The Ultra Steel UJ75041S-1 is a compact 40-piece socket kit with both 1/4 inch and 3/8 inch drive, metric and SAE sockets, a ratchet, an extension bar and a blow-mold carry case. Woot has it new for $12.99 with a limit of three per order. Motorhead Tools sells the same SKU and UPC for $29.99.
